about_the_game:
Naughty Chat is a text-based chat simulator in which you help a girl named Amelia with her master's thesis. Luckily for her, you are just the right person to help her...

Well, not really, you don't know much about her thesis topic... But you have an AI assistant called "Naughty AI" that can help!

Earn money to upgrade it, write the thesis for Amelia, chat with her, and she will soon start rewarding you for your efforts. And who knows, maybe you can get something from her in addition to the money, something really special? It all depends on you!

Naughty Chat will give you:

- About 2 hours of gameplay

- 40 unique high quality renders ⭐️

- Choices that decide what special content you get 🔀

- Flirt with Amelia who will respond to your requests 😈

content_descriptors.notes:
This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: sexting, nudity or sexual content, general mature content, sexual acts.
